patterns.note: Uses a distinct block-based vertical stack with high-contrast background color shifts (cream, lavender, dark green) to clearly demarcate narrative phases.
Combines a classic, high-contrast editorial serif for storytelling headlines with a clean, highly legible geometric sans-serif for UI elements and step-by-step instructions.
Employs a bold, neo-brutalist palette featuring a warm cream base punctuated by large blocks of lavender and forest green, accented with high-saturation yellow and mint green labels.
Features a continuous horizontal marquee ticker for social proof and a terminal-style blinking underscore cursor on key headings to evoke an interactive, retro-tech feel.
Utilizes a structured, numbered step-by-step process layout (Steps 1-3) styled like retro desktop windows with thick black borders and solid drop shadows.

technique_notes: To recreate this aesthetic, combine neo-brutalist UI elements (thick black borders, solid non-blurry drop shadows, and bright color-blocked labels) with nostalgic retro-tech imagery like the vintage Macintosh hero frame. Implement a smooth horizontal marquee for the continuous text ticker, and use CSS keyframes to create a blinking terminal cursor effect on serif headings ending with underscores. Ensure section transitions are sharp and defined by sudden background color changes rather than soft gradients.

design_tokens.type_scale: Medium-contrast editorial serif headings (~3-4x body size) paired with compact, structured sans-serif labels and body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to sharp: sharp 90-degree corners on retro window blocks, paired with pill-shaped buttons and slightly rounded outer container frames.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious vertical padding between major color blocks, contrasted with tight, high-density grids inside the pricing and step-by-step cards.

standout: The integration of a vintage Macintosh computer as the central hero frame, combined with a neo-brutalist 'retro-operating-system' aesthetic for the step-by-step process blocks, gives the site a highly memorable, tactile, and nostalgic personality.
